title: Berkshire 2021 letter: business-pickers, float, buybacks and patience with cash
summary: Buffett's 2021 letter explains that Berkshire picks businesses with durable advantages and first-class CEOs rather than stocks, values insurance float as a sticky source of investable money, and buys back shares only when price is right. It also covers holding huge cash until opportunities meet criteria, and why owners like Paul Andrews choose Berkshire as a permanent home.

principles.text: Buy businesses with durable advantages and first-class CEOs for long-term performance, not timely market moves.
principles.quote: our goal is to have meaningful investments in businesses with both durable economic advantages and a first-class CEO.

principles.text: Think of yourself as a business-picker, not a stock-picker.
principles.quote: Charlie and I are not stock-pickers; we are business-pickers.

principles.text: Insurance float is valuable when it costs less than nothing and is sticky enough to invest for the long term.
principles.quote: Of equal importance, float is very sticky. Funds attributable to our insurance operations come and go daily, but their aggregate total is immune from precipitous decline.

principles.text: Repurchases only make sense when the price/value equation is right; overpaying for your own shares destroys value.
principles.quote: I want to underscore that for Berkshire repurchases to make sense, our shares must offer appropriate value.

principles.text: Low long-term interest rates push up prices of all productive assets, so valuations depend heavily on rates.
principles.quote: Long-term interest rates that are low push the prices of all productive investments upward, whether these are stocks, apartments, farms, oil wells, whatever.

principles.text: Hold a large cash floor to stay financially impregnable and never depend on outside kindness; cash-heavy periods are unpleasant but not permanent.
principles.quote: We want your company to be financially impregnable and never dependent on the kindness of strangers (or even that of friends).
